[[File:SquadsTwoAndThree-DefendersOfPeace.png|thumb|right|250px|Squads 2 and 3]]
'''Squad Three''' was a squad of several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] that were under the command of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]]. They accompanied Lok Durd to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] to test the Neimoidian's new artillery weapon, the [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]], which when detonated could destroy all organic matter in the weapon's blast radius but leave mechanical objects, like the [[battle droid]]s, unharmed. Soon after arriving at the planet and setting up the base camp, Durd carried out a successful first test of the defoliator using a pair of B1 battle droids, which [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] 3 witnessed. Lok then took Squad 3, along with at least two other squads, to test the defoliator on the planet's [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] colony.

However, three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]&mdash;along with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], who had crash-landed on the planet earlier, found out that Lok was going to destroy the Lurmen village, and set out to [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|stop him]]. When the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] arrived at the colony, the Jedi enveloped the colony with a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], using a pair of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] they had stolen from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base camp. The defoliator could not penetrate the deflector shield, so Lok ordered [[Squad One (Lok Durd)/Legends|Squad 1]] to attack the colony, destroy the Jedi, and take down the shield generators. The first squad charged the colony, but the three Jedi and their two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] easily defeated the battle droids, the Jedi cutting down most of the droids with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

Lok then ordered both [[Squad Two (Lok Durd)/Legends|Squad 2]] and Squad 3 together to charge the colony the same way Squad 1 had. The Jedi fought the two squads the same way too, but this time the battle droids broke through the Jedi line and continued on to the colony. Anakin, realizing that the droids might destroy the shield generators and leave the colony exposed, told Ahsoka and Aayla to keep fighting the droids while he went to destroy the defoliator. Meanwhile, the two squads pushed Bly and Rex, who had stayed behind to give covering fire, behind the makeshift barricade the Jedi had built earlier out of some kind of large pods. The droids blew through the barricade and continued on to attack the colony, while the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] fired on the droids from covered positions. Aayla and Ahsoka were still attacking the battle droids, running up from behind them and attacking them while they were attacking the colony. However, they were unable to stop the droids from destroying the shield generators, deactivating the deflector shield.

With the colony now exposed, Lok Durd ordered his remaining forces to load the defoliator and destroy the colony, but Anakin was [[Force speed/Legends|running]] to Lok's position. Durd ordered his droids to fire on the Jedi, but Skywalker evaded the blaster fire and destroyed the defoliator along with several of the droids guarding Lok. The Neimoidian tried to run away and escape, but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] captured him before he could get far. Back at the colony, the remainder of the second and third squads were still attacking the colony, and the village's leader, [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]], a devoted pacifist, did not want his people fight the Separatists even if it meant the destruction of the entire village. However, his son [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]], disgusted by how his father would just sit by and watch the droids kill their people, found several other Lurmen who were willing to fight and attacked the droids. The small colonists went underneath the remaining droids, tying their legs together with rope while the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces distracted the battle droids. Once all the battle droids were tied together, the Lurmen pulled the droids down, whereupon Ahsoka decapitated the droids on the ground. All the battle droids in Squad 2 and Squad 3 were destroyed during the battle.
